title: Continuous Construction Governance Program

authorization_assurance.verified: Exact attributed repository-local authorization bytes, raw-byte digest, closed record shape, and attempt-envelope cross-bindings.
authorization_assurance.not_verified: Human principal identity, signature authenticity, credential provenance, or authority outside the exact candidate record.
authorization_assurance.authority_consequence: The evaluator cannot manufacture owner authority; authority_effect remains none.

claim_limit: Candidate deterministic evaluator only. Exact attributed authorization bytes are verified, but human principal identity and authenticity are not; the evaluator cannot manufacture owner authority. No Constitution adoption, rule activation, stage admission, owner acceptance, routing integration, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
